snippet.title: GladiEATers Demo Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Cook up a team of food-based monsters to command in turn-based battles and become champion of the CALosseum! Chop, fry, boil and bake your GladiEATers as one of *eight Combat Chefs in their storied adventures to the CALosseum in singleplayer, OR take the fight beyond the kitchen in online and ranked multiplayer matches.

GladiEATers will be cooking up a storm on Steam, coming in 2026.
Wishlist GladiEATers Now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141280/GladiEATers/
